body: Send 7 days before the visit. Goal: get a YES or NO reply while there is still time to refill the slot.
Replace the field lines with the real details for each appointment. Keep the tone plain and polite.

body: Hello, this is a confirmation message from the practice named above.
You have an appointment on the date and time listed above.
Please reply YES to confirm or NO if you need to change it.
If you reply NO, our team will contact you to reschedule.

body: Log the reply in the message-performance tracker the same day. A NO reply starts the reschedule workflow and opens the slot for the waitlist.

body: Send 48 hours before the visit to patients who have not yet confirmed plus those who confirmed, as a reminder.
This touch catches schedule conflicts early enough to backfill.

body: This one-page routine covers the daily confirmation flow for front-desk staff.
Post it at the front desk. Review it with every new hire.
sections.heading: Purpose

body: Morning: send same-day reminders, check overnight YES and NO replies, update the log.
Midday: call patients in the single day-before call group who have not replied, per the office call list.
Afternoon: send 7-day and 48-hour touches for upcoming days, move NO slots to the waitlist log.
End of day: reconcile arrivals against the log and record reason codes for no-shows.
sections.heading: Daily routine

body: Contact the next matching waitlist entry within one business hour of a slot opening.
Offer the slot, record accepted or declined, and move to the next entry until filled.
sections.heading: Waitlist rule

body: This kit makes no clinical claims. Message scripts are administrative reminders only and give no medical or dental advice.
